title: Concept: Certificate validation disabled for a connection in swift — review required
description: In swift, certificate validation is switched off for a host. The API is deprecated, which signals legacy networking code, but it still functions on supported systems. Any code path that disables validation turns every subsequent request to that host into an interceptable channel.
applicability: swift iOS applications with legacy NSURLConnection code.
risk: Traffic interception and response substitution; HIGH severity.
